title: test: update guidelines and clean up tests
body:
This is a followup of the work we've done with @dhayab in #5674.

- Slightly updates the README in the common test suite
- Removes leftover tests for breadcrumb we no longer needed
- Puts more tests in common for breadcrumb

We can probably start migrating many tests to the common test suites and remove a lot of other tests. This will make the inconsistencies stand out and we can start better testing our widgets and plan for changes in future majors.
